mapper.select: SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS name, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.use_yn AS useYn, CASE WHEN c.parent_id IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN p.parent_id IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS depth FROM category c LEFT JOIN category p ON c.parent_id = p.category_id ORDER BY c.category_id
